changes_full: WP-10d USB host stack. Four host controller backends verified at device level: UHCI (full chain incl. hub cascade and hot-plug), OHCI (independent session ALL PASS: enumeration with product strings, core 5/5, MSC capacity/MBR/write-read-back, FAT32 round-trip, real hot-plug; fixes: TD_R buffer rounding on control DATA TDs, status-TD direction kept in u32 - the u8 truncation STALLed every status stage, TD_R on interrupt IN), EHCI (kbd/mouse/storage enumeration, MSC rw, FAT32, STALL recovery), XHCI (kbd/mouse enumeration, HID attach, core 5/5; fix: Reset Endpoint / Set TR Dequeue endpoint ID moved to spec bits 20:16 - the old layout made STALL recovery impossible; honest gap: qemu-xhci usb-storage CSW handback). Class drivers: HID keyboard/mouse, MSC storage wired into blk with FAT32 round-trips, CDC-ACM/FTDI serial, UAC 1.0/2.0 audio. usb/usbdev status commands + 7 USB test commands. 159 shell commands, 122 L1 interfaces, 75,806 source lines. BIOS+UEFI boot matrix verified; full regression green.
